title: Keep Inventory Rebalanced
description: Rebalances keep inventory by taking away your levels upon death, respawning you on half health and low hunger to prevent health/hunger resetting
body:
We all know how annoying losing everthing is. But keep inventory feels like cheating! This data pack aims to fix that by taking inspiration from Terraria's way of doing it: Upon death you lose all of your levels, respawn at half health and with low hunger. This way there is still a price to pay for dying, while still keeping things fun and light-hearted!

This data pack enables keep inventory by default so no need to worry about that!
